name: Minghui Zheng
title: Associate Professor
department: J. Mike Walker ’66 Department of Mechanical Engineering
fitReason: The current CtrlRobot lab combines VLA planning, explicit skills and learned recovery for disassembly, plus neural motion planning and human-aware manipulation. SELF-VLA supplies a direct foundation-model-to-physical-action research fit.

physicalEvidence.summary: The March 2026 SELF-VLA primary study uses an actual UR5e with customized Robotiq 2F-85 extension, wrist RealSense D435i and fixed OAK-D Pro. It tests RAM removal and CPU extraction, with 20 trials per reported setting and 528 teleoperated demonstrations. Zheng is a Texas A&M corresponding author and the lab lists this work.

shortVisit.summary: The live opportunities page specifically advertises rolling fully funded PhD and postdoctoral positions. No external-master’s short internship or visitor opening was established. Texas A&M’s central master’s student-intern route is administrative feasibility only.

unknowns: The disassembly components are relocated to a fixture board; the experiment is not autonomous removal from an intact closed desktop. SELF-VLA uses a learned planner/corrector with an explicit recorded skill library, rather than one end-to-end learned controller. Performance varies substantially by backbone; no universal task-success claim is implied. Prospective research scope and access must be confirmed by the host.
